subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: Gandhi Chooses Nonviolence
description: A fast breakdown of Gandhi Chooses Nonviolence for builders.

hook.text: Gandhi chose to fight the British Empire without weapons. Salt, spinning wheels, and marches were his tools.

buildup.text: The Salt March of 1930 protested Britain's salt tax. Thousands walked 240 miles to the sea to make their own salt.

discovery.text: When police beat unarmed marchers, the world watched. Nonviolence turned oppressors into villains on the global stage.

twist.text: Gandhi's strategy required extraordinary discipline. One violent protester could discredit the entire movement.

climax.text: Gandhi proved that choosing how to fight is as important as choosing whether to fight. Method shapes outcome.

punchline.text: No weapons, global impact. Gandhi proved that method shapes outcome.

quiz.question: Why was nonviolence strategically effective for Gandhi?
options: It turned oppressors into villains on the global stage
